 Are you comfortable working on the backend but also enjoy thinking outside the box? Then bring your experience to our team and join us in developing modern software solutions where development, quality, and operations work closely together.
 What makes this job so special? 
As a full-stack developer, you’ll develop and operate our solutions with a clear focus on backend development.
You’ll work with a variety of technologies and programming languages, contributing to the further development of our components on both the backend and frontend.
Through code reviews and automated tests, you’ll work with your team to ensure the high quality and long-term maintainability of our software.
For you, clean code and test-driven development are essential components of professional software development.
In addition to development, DevOps is also part of your daily routine: you’ll ensure the reliable operation of our components in the cloud.
You’ll continuously refine our CI/CD and build pipelines and ensure that development, deployment, and operations processes function reliably.
 Why are you the right fit for this job? 
You have experience in full-stack web development and feel particularly at home with backend development.
You're working with C# and have prior knowledge with C++, in a practical setting; Go is a plus.
You’re also familiar with front-end development: TypeScript, HTML, and SCSS are part of your technical toolkit, and ideally, you’ve already worked with Svelte and Node.js.
You’re well-versed in developing and integrating REST APIs as well as relational databases like PostgreSQL.
Cloud-native development and operations are second nature to you, and you have experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD processes.
You value clean, easily testable code and are eager not only to develop new features but also to work as part of a team to take responsibility for the quality and operation of our solutions.
 Benefits: 
Hybrid work
Flexible benefits (flexible benefits budget with a wide range of options, full freedom of choice, opportunities to save through tax advantages, discounts, offers, and cashback)
Other benefits (parking, extended holiday plan, medical package and dedicated offers with partners from various fields)
Constant access to industry conferences and professional events, supported by the company.
